questions.question: Which of the following curves is known as planning curve?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Long-run average cost curve) है।

questions.question: Which of the following rulers introduced the Malayalam language and script in their inscriptions?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Cheras) है।

questions.question: Which of the following was the decadal growth rate of India's population as per census 2011?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Approx 17.7%) है।

questions.question: The application of drugs/medicines for therapeutic purposes is referred to as _____.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Chemotherapy) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct for C4 plants?
options: They absorb less light than C3 plants.
They absorb less CO2 than C3 plants.
C4 plants have more amount of the enzyme RubisCO.
C4 plants avoid photorespiration by using another enzyme called PEP.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (C4 plants avoid photorespiration by using another enzyme called PEP.) है।

questions.question: In December 2024, the Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT) signed an agreement with which organisation to develop 'Face Recognition Using Drone' under the TTDF Scheme?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Trois Infotech) है।

questions.question: In August 2024, Prime Minister Narendra Modi unveiled how many high-yielding, climate-resilient and biofortified seed varieties, including Bt cotton suitable for rain-fed areas, to boost agricultural productivity and farmers' income?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (109) है।

questions.question: In which of the following states is the special provision of the Inner Line Permit (ILP) applicable?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Arunachal Pradesh) है।

questions.question: Which of the following conditions, set forth by the Minister of Tourism and Culture in 2006, must a language satisfy to be recognised as a classical language in India?A) A minimum of 1500 to 2000 years of recorded historyB) Widespread usage across different regions of IndiaC) A body of ancient literature that is considered valuableD) Should have similarities with its modern offshoots
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (A and C) है।

questions.question: Which of the following options best describes the primary objective of the Indian National Congress during its initial two decades (1885-1905)?
options: Achieving complete independence from British rule
Securing a share in administration through moderate constitutional means
Supporting princely states in administrative reforms
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Securing a share in administration through moderate constitutional means) है।

questions.question: The Indus River flows in India through the district of _____.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Leh) है।

questions.question: Which of the following options is related to the cell's energy currency?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (ATP (adenosine triphosphate)) है।

questions.question: Which of the following operations was reported in May 2025 for protecting Olive Ridley turtles in Odisha?
options: Operation Olivia by the Indian Coast Guard
Mission Turtle Shield by the Wildlife Board
Operation Samudra Raksha by the Indian Navy
Project Ocean Nest by the Ministry of Fisheries
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Operation Olivia by the Indian Coast Guard) है।

questions.question: A school organises Green Drive and encourages students to plant trees. Which of the Fundamental Duties is being inculcated among the students?
options: To value and preserve the rich heritage
To develop scientific temper and humanism
To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
To protect and improve the natural environment
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (To protect and improve the natural environment) है।

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the Deen Dayal Upadhyay Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) scheme of Government of India?
options: To promote urban migration for employment
To skill rural youth and provide them with jobs with regular wages
To offer direct financial assistance to all rural households
To provide free housing to rural youth
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To skill rural youth and provide them with jobs with regular wages) है।

questions.question: How does privatisation aim to enhance economic efficiency?
options: By increasing government control over enterprises
By focussing only on the public sector
By transferring ownership to private entities, increasing competition and innovation
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (By transferring ownership to private entities, increasing competition and innovation) है।

questions.question: Who among the following is NOT eligible to hold office for a second term?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Chairperson of the UPSC) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Chhath festival is/are correct?I. Chhath is dedicated to the Sun God.II. It is celebrated in the Kartik month.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Both I and II) है।

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the constitution of a commission to make recommendations for the progressive use of Hindi for official purposes of the Union?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Article 344(1)) है।

questions.question: How many Indian members were appointed in the ‘Indian Statutory Commission’ during the British period?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Zero) है।
